page_title: CEL 2-3 LEV | Celta Vigo v Levante 12/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' One of the players from Celta Vigo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+8' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+8' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+7' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Williot Swedberg collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
90+7' A spell of possession for Celta Vigo in an attempt to control the game.
90+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Mathew Ryan (Levante).
90' Mathew Ryan (Levante) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Espi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ivan Romero (Levante).
84' The attendance for today's match is 19185.

84' He should have scored! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Mathew Ryan makes an easy save.
83' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
82' Roger Brugue (Levante) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
81' Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

79' Roger Brugue (Levante) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Ionut Radu!
79' A sweet pass inside the box gives Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
77' A substitution has been made. Diego Varela Pampin is replaced by Manu Sanchez (Levante).
76' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Ferran Jutgla will be replaced by Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Sotelo departs the field of play to be replaced by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo).
74' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
72' Levante are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
70' A player from Celta Vigo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
66' Substitution. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) replaces Javier Rueda.
66' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Hugo Alvarez and he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
66' Here comes a substitution. Iago Aspas is given a rest as he is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
63' 2 - 3 Goal! Roger Brugue (Levante) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:3.
63' Levante have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Victor Garcia is replaced by Roger Brugue (Levante).
61' Substitution. Pablo Martinez Andres makes way for Ugo Raghouber (Levante).
60' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
60' It looks like Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) saw red with that tackle. Adrian Cordero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

57' 2 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Dela (Levante) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Ionut Radu just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:2.
56' Iker Losada (Levante) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
52' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo).
51' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Levante manage to earn a corner.
48' 2 - 1 Goal! Javier Rueda plays a simple square pass into the feet of Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
46' A substitution has been made. Kareem Tunde goes off and Iker Losada (Levante) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+2' A loose ball is pounced on by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mathew Ryan is alert and makes a comfortable save.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' 1 - 1 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper Ionut Radu makes a complete hash of a weak mid range shot from Kervin Arriaga (Levante) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 1:1.
43' Kareem Tunde (Levante) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
43' Some great controlled play and passing from Levante. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) serves up a nice cross, but Ionut Radu punches the ball away.
36' A thunderous effort from long range by Dela (Levante) goes well wide of the left post.
34' Kareem Tunde (Levante) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
32' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Mathew Ryan comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
24' Dela (Levante) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Carlos Espi (Levante) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar.
17' Victor Garcia (Levante) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.

12' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, and he produces a promising goal-bound header to the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu pulls off a decent save to deny him.
11' Chance! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
8' Kareem Tunde (Levante) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box.
4' 1 - 0 Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) was like a fox in the box, burying the ball into the bottom right corner of the goal. Excellent finish!

3' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Mathew Ryan anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
2' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' A player from Levante commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Levante will kick the game off.
